title: TMSAT certificate characterization
statement: Let $c$ be a machine representation scheme and let $y$ be a bit string. Then $y\\in\\mathrm{TMSAT}_c$ if and only if there is a bit string $w$ of length $|y|+1$ such that $yw$ belongs to the verifier language $V_c$.
replaced: Let $c$ be a machine-representation scheme, which assigns to every bit string $\alpha$ a one-work-tape binary Turing machine $M_\alpha$ (decoding is total). For every bit string $y$, $y \in \mathrm{TMSAT}_c$ if and only if there is a bit string $w$ with $|w| = |y| + 1$ and $yw \in V_c$. Here, with $\langle\alpha,\langle x,\langle 1^n,1^t\rangle\rangle\rangle$, where $\langle a,b\rangle$ is the self-delimiting pair encoding and $1^k$ is the word of $k$ ones, $\mathrm{TMSAT}_c$ is the set of strings $\langle\alpha,\langle x,\langle 1^n,1^t\rangle\rangle\rangle$, over all bit strings $\alpha, x$ and $n, t \in \mathbb{N}$, such that $M_\alpha$ halts on $\langle x,u\rangle$ within $t$ steps with output exactly $1$ for some $u$ with $|u| = n$, and $V_c$ is the set of strings $y'w'$ with $|w'| = |y'|+1$ and $y' = \langle\alpha,\langle x,\langle 1^n,1^t\rangle\rangle\rangle$ for some $\alpha, x, n, t$ such that $M_\alpha$ halts on $\langle x, w'_{[:n]}\rangle$ within $t$ steps with output exactly $1$, where $w'_{[:n]}$ is the first $n$ bits of $w'$.
